title: Security startup finds more than 13,000 internal company screenshots that AI agents uploaded publicly
summary_raw: AI agents quietly posted more than 13,000 internal screenshots from 343 organizations, including Fortune 500 companies, to public GitHub repos. title: OpenAI says it stopped a campaign to steal its models' reasoning, but the trick still worked on Azure
summary_raw: OpenAI says it stopped a coordinated campaign in which more than 15,000 accounts tried to copy the hidden reasoning of its models. So far, OpenAI's protections don't seem to extend to the cloud platforms that also sell its models.
